text: On the road, two small habits keep families informed and your day on track.
You're leaving your last stop. Next is Biscuit Chen.
The one thing to remember: send On My Way when you leave the house before, and record the real start and end times.
Right-click, On Visit Day, Send On My Way Text.
Put in how many minutes away you are.
The message updates. You can edit it, for example to add your name.
Messages history shows every text the family has had from us.
When you arrive, open Start / End Visit.
Save. You can save the start any time.
When you leave, open it again, click Now, end, and Save.

The most common mistakes: sending On My Way from the depot hours ahead, and never saving the end time. Remember: send On My Way when you leave the house before, and record the real start and end times.
